news.title: Binance $6.3B record hack sparks pre-election political chatter
news.summary: Some political and administration figures tried to make hay of the biggest-ever crypto heist.

news.title: Bitcoin stolen from Binance tops Tesla’s holdings and is over twice El Salvador’s reserve
news.summary: The 18,270 BTC haul is worth about $1.4 billion and comes within 442 coins of SpaceX’s disclosed holdings. Blockchain investigators link the attack to North Korea.

news.title: OpenAI reportedly cuts fundraising and valuation targets amid AI jitters
news.summary: Anxiety about the AI boom has sent the Nasdaq 100 slumping by about 10% in just three weeks since hitting a record high on October 6, including a 4.5% drop on Friday.

news.title: Binance hackers raced to move billions before it could be frozen
news.summary: Attackers raced to convert stolen stablecoins into crypto that issuers could not freeze as industry players like Tether and Circle moved to immobilize billions of dollars in assets.

news.title: Inside the largest crypto hack on record: How attackers breached Binance for $6.3 billion
news.summary: Investigators tie the $6B Binance hack to North Korea. Here's how hot-wallet signing infrastructure was compromised and where funds went.

news.title: President Trump says they’re looking into Binance hack as calls grow for crypto rules
news.summary: Following the $6.3 billion hack of the world's largest crypto exchange, Binance, calls are growing for legislation.

news.title: Experts divided over Binance hack asset freezes, warn recovery is another matter
news.summary: Tether, Circle and others moved within hours to block billions in stolen crypto, but legal experts question whether smaller victims would get the same protection.

news.title: Tether’s excess reserves nearly double to $8B as Q3 profit hits $1.5B
news.summary: The stablecoin issuer’s US Treasury holdings are comparable to those of major foreign holders, while its Bitcoin reserves were valued at $8.37 billion at the end of September.

news.title: Coinbase leads crypto stock selloff following $6.3B Binance hack
news.summary: Circle, Strategy and other crypto-linked stocks fell sharply Friday, a day after Binance disclosed a $6.3 billion security breach.

news.title: Crypto Biz: Bitcoin’s quantum threat is becoming an economic problem
news.summary: Bitcoin faces mounting quantum security concerns as Ripple secures a US banking charter, USDC gains ground in Europe and VanEck adds BTC to a new ETF.

news.title: Recap: How Binance’s record $6.3B hack unfolded
news.summary: A recap of Cointelegraph’s live coverage of the Binance hack, including early breach reports and the exchange’s full reimbursement pledge.

news.title: As it happened: Binance’s record $6.3B crypto hack
news.summary: How Binance’s $6.3 billion hack unfolded, from the first onchain alerts to $3 billion in frozen funds and a widening security investigation.

news.title: Binance uncovers wider breach in $6.3 billion exploit, targets Sunday withdrawal restart
news.summary: CEO Richard Teng said hackers erased evidence and bypassed security checks. Binance plans to publish its proof of reserves Monday.

news.title: Texas brothers sentenced to 15 years for holding Minnesota family at gunpoint in $8 million crypto heist
news.summary: Two brothers who held a family for nine hours at gunpoint in Minnesota for $8 million worth of cryptocurrency were sentenced on Friday.

news.title: Bitcoin risks worst October in 12 years as tech sell-off spreads to gold
news.summary: Bitcoin circled $77,000 as crypto markets navigated US stock-market downside, while the gold price fell to its lowest in a year.

news.title: Strategy’s preferred-stock fix sets up renewed bitcoin buying, analysts say
news.summary: Strategy fell after Q3 earnings, but StoneX & TD Cowen kept buy ratings, citing $4.83B cash reserve and more stable STRC preferred structure.

news.title: Wall Street analysts urge investors to buy crypto stocks after $6.3 billion Binance hack
news.summary: Analysts at Cantor Fitzgerald, TD Cowen and Compass Point say the $6.3 billion Binance hack is unlikely to derail the crypto market's recovery.

news.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

news.title: Will gold’s ‘infinite mint bug’ make Bitcoin more valuable?
news.summary: A US fusion startup says it has turned mercury into gold. Could a potential increase in the gold supply strengthen Bitcoin’s claim to be a better form of digital gold?

news.title: Binance says it has $6.34 billion ready to cover hack losses
news.summary: Binance has allocated $6.34 billion to cover hack losses, while industry partners have frozen another $3 billion in affected assets.

news.title: FBI and Secret Service join response to Binance’s $6.3B hack
news.summary: US agencies are investigating the theft and helping trace stolen assets, while Binance says about $3 billion has been frozen.

news.title: Binance says it holds $5B in matching tokens to cover hack losses
news.summary: The exchange said it set aside more than $6.34 billion to cover losses and would include the assets in its next proof-of-reserves report.

news.title: Binance arranges $6.34 billion to cover losses from record crypto hack
news.summary: Binance said it reserved its own funds to cover the $6.3 billion hack, including freezes of roughly $3 billion in stolen assets.

news.title: Here's how big bitcoin traders responded after the Binance hack hit
news.summary: Your day-ahead look for Oct. 30, 2026

news.title: Zcash grants group offers $124M compromise as governance backlash grows
news.summary: Zcash Community Grants proposed redirecting about $124 million in existing and future funding toward mining rewards, but critics say the plan fails to address governance and accountability concerns.

news.title: Here’s how an Ethereum upgrade helped drain part of Binance’s $6 billion loss
news.summary: On Ethereum, the attacker used a 2025 upgrade built to make ordinary wallets smarter, armed with 50 signatures from Binance's own wallet.

news.title: Bitcoin price metrics hint at rebound as $1.6B liquidations follow Binance hack
news.summary: Bitcoin held above $76,000 after a $6.3 billion Binance hack and a tech-stock sell-off, as momentum indicators pointed to a possible rebound.

news.title: Crypto liquidations jump to $1.57 billion as Binance hack sends bitcoin, ether lower
news.summary: Bitcoin traded near $77,350 after $6.3 billion Binance hack, with crypto futures liquidations jumping to $1.57 billion.

news.title: EIP-7702 didn’t cause Binance hack, but may have amplified losses
news.summary: Security experts said attackers could have drained Binance’s wallets without EIP-7702, but the Ethereum upgrade may have helped bypass withdrawal safeguards.

news.title: Binance hacker’s Bitcoin haul tops Coinbase’s corporate treasury
news.summary: The attackers held 18,270 BTC early Friday, topping Coinbase’s reported corporate holdings, and an Ether stash exceeding 500,000 ETH.

news.title: THORChain’s RUNE jumps 13% after Binance’s record $6.3B hack
news.summary: North Korean hackers previously used THORChain to move funds stolen from Bybit and Bitget, prompting calls for the protocol to intervene.

news.title: Strategy CFO Andrew Kang resigns as company posts record operating profit
news.summary: Andrew Kang’s departure comes as Strategy reports $21 billion in quarterly operating income and bitcoin holdings of 848,517 BTC.

news.title: Trezor warns CryptoBilis buyers to move funds over suspected implant
news.summary: Trezor urged customers who bought devices from CryptoBilis since March to move their funds after a report of a suspected hardware implant.

news.title: Coinbase Q3 net income jumps 66% as prediction markets gain traction
news.summary: Bernstein analysts said Coinbase's expanding prediction markets and derivatives businesses helped offset weaker spot trading activity.

news.title: Trezor reports suspected hardware implant in Safe 5 sold by CryptoBilis
news.summary: Trezor urged CryptoBilis buyers to migrate funds after receiving a credible report of a hardware implant inside a Safe 5 device.

news.title: Live updates: Bitcoin falls below $77,000 as Binance exploit combines with tech woes
news.summary: The $6.3 billion Binance hack added to crypto jitters, while weak earnings outlooks and mounting concerns over AI spending pushed the Nasdaq down more than 2%.

news.title: Binance hacker dumps a little-known 2017 token and it crashes 90%
news.summary: The hacker dumped FUN and other smaller tokens into markets too small to absorb large selling, leading to price crashes.

news.title: Bitcoin, ether and XRP selloff wipes out $1.5 billion in leveraged crypto bets
news.summary: Bets on rising prices accounted for nearly 84% of forced closures, with Binance handling almost half the total. A rebound has since started catching short sellers.

news.title: Strategy eyes more Bitcoin buys as Saylor touts $30B credit capacity
news.summary: Michael Saylor says Strategy could create up to $30 billion in digital credit without new common-stock fundraising or further Bitcoin price gains, as the company plans more BTC purchases.

news.title: North Korea’s TraderTraitor linked to $6.3B Binance hack
news.summary: TRM Labs said it has high confidence in the attribution, while ZachXBT identified stolen funds from the Binance and Bitget hacks converging at the same address.

news.title: XRP Ledger developers tighten the rules for who can hold 'restricted' tokens
news.summary: A set of fixes would tighten who can hold permissioned tokens on the network. The XRP Ledger Foundation says no users were affected.

news.title: Binance hack bites India's largest crypto exchange as it curbs futures trading
news.summary: CoinDCX has restricted new futures positions after Binance’s security incident disrupted a key liquidity provider. Deposits, withdrawals and customer funds remain unaffected, the exchange said.

news.title: Binance hacker splits $1.4 billion of bitcoin into 19 wallets that no one can freeze
news.summary: All 18,270 coins sit in 19 wallets, 17 of them holding exactly 1,000 BTC each, and none has moved since Thursday night, a CoinDesk trace of the blockchain shows.

news.title: Standard Chartered sees more pain after $6 billion Binance hack sends bitcoin lower
news.summary: Bitcoin and ether slid after a suspected $6.3 billion Binance security breach and a Polymarket exploit. Standard Chartered says crypto prices may remain under pressure before finding a base.

news.title: Institutional crypto investors rush to pull funds from exchanges after Binance hack
news.summary: The withdrawals suggest the fallout from the multibillion-dollar breach is spreading beyond Binance.

news.title: Binance hack could accelerate shift to DEXs: Standard Chartered
news.summary: Standard Chartered’s Geoffrey Kendrick said the breach could accelerate a shift toward decentralized trading and strengthen his case for Uniswap’s UNI token reaching $100 by 2030.

news.title: Crypto's longtime foe, North Korea's Lazarus Group, likely behind Binance hack: blockchain sleuths
news.summary: Security researchers suggested that the hermit kingdom's Lazarus Group was behind Thursday's nearly $6 billion hack of the world's largest crypto exchange.

news.title: Bitcoin slides below $77,000, BNB drops amid Binance hack
news.summary: BNB lost 7.1%, while Binance Co-CEO Yi He pledged that the exchange will cover all user losses resulting from the hack.

news.title: Binance hack drained wallets backing customer assets, reserve data shows
news.summary: Binance’s own reserve data lists the drained wallets as backing customer balances, leaving its ether backing an estimated 6% short until the exchange replaces what was stolen.

news.title: Binance points to engineer’s hacked laptop in $6.3B breach
news.summary: Binance said attackers may have used a compromised DevOps laptop to access internal infrastructure.

news.title: Binance hack rattles markets as BNB falls 8%, Bitcoin nears $77K
news.summary: Bitcoin, Ether and the broader crypto market took a dive as Binance suffered a multibillion-dollar hack.

news.title: Tampered Ledger reported in Singapore a month before news broke: Asia Express
news.summary: Singapore police say tampered Ledgers started showing up there on September 10. South Korean lawmakers look set to delay the crypto tax law for a fourth time.

news.title: Binance investigating hack as suspicious outflows reach up to $5.8 billion
news.summary: Tether and Circle froze $1.79 billion in USDT and USDC after billions moved out of Binance hot wallets. Binance says it is investigating.

news.title: Binance hit by $6.3B hack, the largest in cryptocurrency history
news.summary: Binance pledged to cover all losses after a $6.3 billion hack, with about $3 billion in assets frozen by the exchange and its partners.

news.title: Binance loses over $6 billion in 'biggest crypto hack in history'
news.summary: Crypto prices are sliding on the news, with bitcoin falling back to $77,000, though Binance's co-CEO said it would cover all losses.

news.title: Strategy reports $19.5 billion in Q3 net income as preferred shareholders approve daily dividends
news.summary: Strategy reported $19.53B in Q3 net income on a $20.91B bitcoin gain, holds 848,517 BTC, and moves preferreds to daily dividends.

news.title: Polymarket resumes trading after $2.65 million exploit, says third-party provider was compromised
news.summary: After over $2.5 million was lost within minutes on Polymarket, the platform said it has since placed its exchange in cancel-only mode.

news.title: Polymarket suspends trading after third-party breach leads to user losses
news.summary: Polymarket said one of its third-party providers was breached after users reported seeing their accounts drained.

news.title: Stanley Druckenmiller's first X post backs Hyperliquid venture after $23 million indirect investment
news.summary: The billionaire investor disclosed an investment in Trade[XYZ] as the platform teams up with the NYSE's parent company. His family office previously reported owning shares in a HYPE-focused treasury company.

news.title: KuCoin exits Russia and Belarus as crypto exchanges withdraw from Western-sanctioned markets
news.summary: The exchange is closing accounts in both countries after MEXC and Bitget announced similar moves earlier this month.

news.title: From rivals to partners: Polygon and Solana team to bring stablecoin payments to banks
news.summary: The two networks are setting aside their rivalry to connect Solana's stablecoin activity with Polygon's banking, wallet and payment infrastructure.

news.title: HYPE surges 15% as NYSE parent ICE moves to bring Hyperliquid perps to US
news.summary: NYSE parent ICE will partner with and invest in Trade[XYZ] to launch regulated, Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures in the U.S.

news.title: Uniswap Labs opens fee conversion tool TJAR to apps, starting with Robinhood
news.summary: Uniswap Labs has opened up its Token Jar fee conversion system to other apps through a new tool called TJAR.

news.title: Polygon adds Solana to payment stack linking bank accounts, crypto and payouts
news.summary: Polygon added Solana to its payments platform, connecting businesses to bank funding, cross-chain transfers, stablecoins and global payouts.

news.title: Curve Finance launches on Stellar in first native deployment outside EVM ecosystem
news.summary: Curve Finance has launched on Stellar mainnet, its first native deployment outside the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) ecosystem.

news.title: Utah files criminal charges against Kalshi, executives over alleged illegal gambling
news.summary: Utah AG Derek Brown filed criminal charges against Kalshi, Tarek Mansour and Luana Lopes Lara for allegedly promoting online gambling.

news.title: Robinhood earnings miss, crypto weakness fail to shake Wall Street’s bullish outlook
news.summary: Bernstein sees Robinhood’s crypto business shifting toward infrastructure as new products like prediction markets and perps gain ground.

news.title: Bitwise raises bitcoin price target to $1.6 million by 2036, projects 34% annualized returns
news.summary: Bitwise's bear case puts bitcoin at $130,686 by 2036, while its bull case reaches $3.67 million over the next decade.

news.title: Coinbase adds Ripple’s RLUSD stablecoin across retail, exchange and Prime platforms
news.summary: RLUSD is live on Coinbase with 1:1 USD conversion on XRP Ledger, Ethereum and Base, capping a big week of news for Ripple.

news.title: Avail launches ShieldTX privacy tool targeting copy-trading bots on Hyperliquid
news.summary: Avail launched ShieldTX, a Hyperliquid privacy tool that creates a separate wallet for each perpetual futures position.
